# Pinned pip dependencies for continuous integration itself, as distinct from
# ansible/requirements-test.txt, which pins the Ansible test framework.
#
# Both pins are exact, per AGENTS.md: "any external role or collection used for
# any purpose is pinned to an exact version, never a floating range". Two
# installs at different times must not resolve different versions and silently
# change what a check actually checks.
#
# pre-commit: pr-validation.yml runs the ansible-lint and syntax-check hooks
# through pre-commit rather than re-expressing their invocations, so the hook
# pins in .pre-commit-config.yaml stay the single source of truth. Nothing in
# this repository pinned pre-commit before this file existed;
# .github/workflows/pre-commit-autoupdate.yml still installs it with a bare
# `pip install pre-commit`. Bringing that onto this file is a one-line fix in a
# workflow this change does not otherwise touch, and it is recorded in
# docs/change-queue.md rather than folded in here.
#
# PyYAML: the CI-configuration test suite (.github/tests/) parses workflow YAML
# with it. It previously reached this repository only transitively, via
# ansible-core -- which is not a pin, merely a version that happened to be
# resolved. 6.0.1 is the version those tests were verified against.
pre-commit==4.6.2
PyYAML==6.0.1
